notes: New: Compressor guide. Open any Compressor in Logic and Ganio numbers the main knobs, explains each one beside the window, and paints the green gain-reduction target on the meter (the zones switch in the menu turns it off). Also: every EQ band dot shows during coaching, a Stop button is always on the coach bubble, and the EQ zones now match Ganio's settings (Attack, Snap, Presence, Air and more).
